state_profile.voting_summary: Texas votes early: 75% of its 2024 vote came from two weeks of early in-person voting, with excuse-required mail at 4%. Polls close at 9 p.m. Eastern (10 p.m. in El Paso); pre-processed early and mail votes are released right after closing (usually the majority of the statewide vote in one wave), then election day precincts report into the early morning, with big metro counties finishing last. Early voting ran R+14 and election day R+16 while mail ran D+21, so margins hold fairly steady after the initial dump.
